query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name') FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='hermes.gateway.up' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name')!='' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gateway up

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, '' AS series, max(v) AS value FROM (SELECT time, fp, cluster, anyLast(v) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='hermes.gateway.up' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='hermes.gateway.up' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: 1 while the gateway process reports state=running.

panels.title: Active agents

panels.title: HTTP requests/s by route

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, g AS "http.route", sum(r) AS value FROM (SELECT time, fp, g, cluster, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v,1,v) OVER (PARTITION BY fp, g ORDER BY time), 0) / $__interval_s AS r FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'http.route') AS g, JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, max(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='http.server.request.duration.count' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='http.server.request.duration.count' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.namespace.name')='hermes-carolyn' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, g, cluster)) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, g ORDER BY time

panels.description: Server requests per second on the pod's listeners, split by route, from OBI eBPF instrumentation.

panels.title: HTTP requests/s by status

panels.description: Errors show up here first: a 5xx that keeps climbing is the Webapp or an MCP sidecar failing.
